title: Proxy receipt, chain line (contract C4, spec 0.1)
description: One line of the receipt chain. It is proxy/internal/receipts.Receipt; a line is exactly the JSON encoding of this object with the keys in this order and no others (a reader refuses anything else). spec/evidence.md gives the signing form and the chain rules.

v.description: Absent for a legacy v1 receipt.

status.description: The upstream status; 0 when nothing was forwarded.

phase.description: attempt: written and synced before any byte goes upstream; outcome: written once the upstream answered or failed. Absent when the request never went upstream.

attempt_id.description: On an outcome receipt, the receipt_id of its attempt.

agent.description: A stable hash of the client credential ("pt_<sha256[:16]>"), or absent with client auth off.

resp_bytes.description: -1 when the upstream streamed without a length.

kid.description: The id of the key that signed (receipts.KeyID of its public key).

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the previous line's bytes; empty on the first receipt of a chain.

signature.description: Ed25519 over the signing form (spec/evidence.md), hex.
